text: Risk management is the process of dealing with possible problems before they happen. The first step is identifying risks, which means finding out what could go wrong in a project or business. After that, you need mitigation strategies, which are actions to reduce the chance or impact of these risks. For example, you might train staff or buy insurance. It is also wise to prepare contingency plans, so you have a backup solution if a risk actually occurs. Finally, monitoring is essential because risks can change over time. By checking regularly, you can update your plans and stay in control. Good risk management helps you avoid surprises and protect your goals.
